🟡 News Updates: November 21-22, 2026 🇵🇸 Palestine — A Palestinian civilian succumbed to injuries sustained from Israeli occupation forces’ gunfire in Halawa Camp, north of the Gaza Strip. — A high-level Hamas delegation, headed by Political Bureau Chief Khalil al-Hayya, met with Ibrahim Kalin, head of Turkey’s National Intelligence Organisation (MIT), for talks. 🇾🇪 Yemen — Saudi shelling targeted border villages in the Haydan district of Saada Governorate. — The Yemeni Armed Forces carried out a strike targeting Jizan. — Several explosions were heard in Hodeidah. — Security agencies in Al-Dhale Governorate announced that they had foiled a plot attributed to Saudi intelligence and seized two booby-trapped vehicles, a car and a motorcycle, allegedly equipped for suicide operations. The car was intercepted at 7:20 AM while being driven by 31-year-old Shukri Aref Haidar Shalfan, whom the authorities described as an Al-Qaeda member. According to the statement, both vehicles had travelled from areas controlled by what it called the aggression forces and were heading towards Dhamar Governorate. — Moments ago, Saudi-led airstrike on the Haifan district in the Taiz province of Yemen. 🇮🇷 Iran — Qatari envoy Ali al-Zoubi visited Tehran the previous night to hold talks with Iranian officials as part of efforts to resume negotiations between America and Iran, citing a source familiar with the matter. 🇸🇦 Saudi Arabia — Two powerful explosions were heard in Riyadh. — Explosions were also reported in Taif and Jeddah. Jeddah Airport was reportedly closed following a Yemeni attack. 🇱🇧 Lebanon — Israeli forces shelled areas near Al-Mari and Ibl al-Saqi. Four artillery shells struck the vicinity of Al-Majidiyah, outside Al-Mari, while six shells targeted the river sector outside Ibl al-Saqi. Several bombings were also carried out near Bani Hayyan and Hadatha. — Israeli attacks across Lebanon on 21 November: air raids, shelling, explosions and explosive drones Air raids hit Kafr Tibnit, the Qantara outskirts and the outskirts of Baraashit, while artillery shelling was reported in Houla, Al-Mansouri, Ibl al-Saqi, Al-Majidiyah-Al-Mari, Wadi al-Salouqi, Wadi Zibqin, Kafr Tibnit, Wadi al-Hujair, Hadatha, the outskirts of Baraashit, Rashaf, Al-Khiam, the outskirts of Mayfadoun, Zawtar al-Sharqiyah, Bani Hayyan and Al-Qantara. Explosions were reported in Al-Qantara, Masha'a al-Mansouri, Shihin, Al-Muhaysibiyat-Al-Qantara and Zawtar al-Sharqiyah, and phosphorus bombs in Al-Khiam. Explosive drones were reported over Shukin and Al-Nabatiyah al-Fawqa, explosive gallons in Hadatha, and illuminating flares over Zawtar al-Sharqiyah-Yahmar al-Shaqif. 🌎 Regional Military Activity — A total of 69 military aircraft were detected in the region over the past 24 hours. These included six transport aircraft arriving from outside the region: four American, one French and one of unknown origin.
